extracted.intended_audience: news editors, newsroom managers, analytics leads and researchers interested in newsroom analytics
extracted.subtask_description: Assessing and designing how news organisations develop and use audience data and metrics to inform editorial decision making, based on interviews and review of current trends and leading practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sophisticated analytics strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: What constitutes a sophisticated analytics strategy?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report examines which organisations are building a competitive advantage through a better understanding of their audience and asks what a sophisticated strategy looks like, based on over 30 interviews with senior figures involved in developing analytics in news organisations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoiding a rudimentary approach to analytics
rubrics_metrics.description: Why are so many media organisations still using such a rudimentary approach to analytics?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies common simplistic uses of metrics in editorial decision making and highlights the gap between rudimentary practice and more advanced, strategic use of audience data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Building competitive advantage via audience understanding
rubrics_metrics.description: Organisations can build a competitive advantage over less advanced competitors through a better understanding of their audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report looks at leading organisations to show how deeper audience understanding translates into competitive benefits and draws lessons others can take from their approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of analytics in editorial decision making
rubrics_metrics.description: News organisations are increasingly embracing the use of analytics and metrics as part of editorial decision making.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The study reviews current trends in how analytics are integrated into editorial workflows and where organisations are falling behind in leveraging these tools effectively.
